description: This Java class 'PcbMergeTool' manages PCB merging operations, including copying, optimizing, adding, moving components, and merging PCB netlists. It orchestrates reading PCB files, applying changes based on a configuration, and writing the merged result.

classes.name: PcbMergeTool
classes.description: Main class for PCB merging operations including copying, optimization, merging, and updating PCB files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to run the PCB merge process with source, destination, and change list files.

methods.name: findModuleByName
methods.description: Finds a module in the PCB node tree by its reference name.

methods.name: mergePcb
methods.description: Merges source PCB nodes into the destination PCB node, handling nets, zones, arcs, lines, labels, modules, segments, and vias.

methods.name: removeNodes
methods.description: Removes modules from PCB if they meet removal criteria.

methods.name: shouldRemove
methods.description: Determines if a module should be removed based on its electronic references.

methods.name: fixNetId
methods.description: Fixes and updates net IDs and names in PCB nodes during merging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs log messages to the console.
